issues.detail: The Hebrew name אֶלְעָשָׂה (Elasah) is rendered as 以拉撒人, which adds 人 (person) and changes the name; it should be 以拉撒 (Elasah). Also, סִֽסְמַי (Sismai) is rendered as 西斯瑪伊人, adding 人; the correct name is 西斯瑪伊. The name שַׁלּוּם (Shallum) is rendered as 沙魯姆, which is a different transliteration (Shallum vs. Shalum) — this is a name swap.
